links.label: Gridscale X Protection Data Manager Handle growing volumes of protection data efficiently. Our software automates relay data imports, saving up to 80% of time, increasing accuracy, and providing a single source of truth for grid stability.

Dynamic Line Rating Gridscale X Dynamic Line Rating calculates line capacity in real-time using local weather data. Increase capacity by 10-15% over 90% of the time, reduce redispatching costs, and bridge capacity gaps.

Dynamic Security Assessment Transport 30% more power through existing lines. Our automated software provides real-time stability assessments to increase grid capacity, improve situational awareness, and prevent blackouts. Push your grid limits securely.

Advanced Distribution Management Manage grid complexity and the energy transition. Spectrum Power ADMS integrates DERs, visualizes processes, and optimizes assets across all voltage levels to ensure reliable power, reduce costs, and boost efficiency.

Gridscale X LV Management Handle outages up to 30% faster and cut model maintenance time in half with Gridscale X LV Management. This smart co-pilot SaaS provides guided workflows to enhance grid stability, optimize assets, and resupply power faster.

Network Model Manager Unleash network model management with Gridscale X. Our fast, scalable, and open platform provides a single source of truth for grid data. Keep models consistent, boost team productivity, and accelerate planning and operations.

PSS E The industry benchmark for transmission planning and analysis. PSS®E delivers trusted results and unmatched automation. Save time and streamline complex workflows with over 2,000+ open Python™ APIs.

PSS SINCAL PSS®SINCAL is an all-in-one simulation software for electric and pipe networks. Reliably plan expansions, analyze protection, and integrate renewables across LV, MV, and HV systems with fast, accurate calculations.

Gridscale X Meter Data Management Simplify metering with our scalable, vendor-agnostic MDM. Automate data operations, resolve 99.9% of issues, and improve billing accuracy. Get the job done 85% faster and future-proof your utility against vendor lock-in.

Gridscale X Prepay Gridscale X Prepay protects utility revenue with a central wallet for real-time rating, flexible tariffs & debt recovery. This improves cash flow while empowering consumers with budget control & self-service.

Gridscale X Meter Data Management SaaS Manage electric, water, and gas meter data with our vendor-agnostic MDM SaaS. Avoid vendor lock-in, increase billing accuracy, and reduce TCO. Deploy 3x faster with a scalable, secure, and future-proof cloud solution.

Gridscale X Meter Data Management for Water A vendor-agnostic MDM for water utilities. Process smart meter data to detect leaks, backflow, and theft, reducing revenue loss. Our scalable solution ensures future-proof operations and avoids vendor lock-in.
How AI manages building and data center systems

Gridscale X LV Insights Gridscale X LV Insights is a SaaS that creates a Digital Twin of your LV grid. Automate model creation to improve data quality by 90%, identify critical segments, and make confident investment decisions.

GRIDSCALE X DER Insights Gridscale X DER Insights uncovers BTM DERs and their grid impact using an accurate model. Make data-driven decisions to prioritize upgrades, prevent issues, and fully leverage DER flexibility.

Gridscale X Advanced Protection Assessment Power accurate protection simulations with the world's largest library of 7,300+ detailed relay models. Automate wide-area coordination and streamline NERC compliance for enhanced grid reliability.

props.c3dtext: Observation data connects with a wider community, helping users validate targets and discover more nights worth keeping.

props.fb1dtext: The experience removes the ceremony that usually blocks new observers: alignment, tracking, and image capture all happen in a guided flow.

props.herotitletext: See the night with observatory intelligence in your hands.
props.herobodytext: Find galaxies, nebulae, and hidden sky detail in seconds through adaptive optics and guided live targeting built for serious exploration.

props.featuressubtext: Envision combines adaptive optics, live recognition, and guided storytelling so every session flows from first target to cinematic reveal.
props.card1bodytext: Auto-calibrated optics continuously rebalance contrast and glare, keeping faint structure visible as sky conditions shift.
props.card2bodytext: Real-time recognition identifies objects, events, and context overlays so you understand what you are seeing in the moment.
props.card3bodytext: A refined guidance flow recommends next-best targets and framing cues, turning each observation into a directed journey.

props.usetitletext: One Platform, Every Stage of Night Exploration
props.usesubtext: Begin with private sky rituals, scale into guided group experiences, and graduate to institution-grade observation workflows.
props.usecard1bodytext: Transform rooftops and terraces into cinematic observatories with curated object highlights, gentle guidance, and premium optics tuned for calm nightly practice.
props.usecard2bodytext: Coordinate clubs, retreats, and hosted events with synchronized targets, shared wayfinding, and effortless facilitation across every participant.
props.usecard3bodytext: Support academic labs and advanced initiatives with cleaner visual output, contextual object intelligence, and repeatable observation standards.

props.appliesbodytext: Customers, community users, prospects, and visitors interacting with Unistellar websites, applications, support channels, and device-connected experiences.
props.contactbodytext: Email legal@unistellar.com for formal notices, privacy requests, or accessibility concerns related to this policy center.
props.privacybodytext: We collect only the information required to support accounts, commerce, connected devices, and service reliability, and we do not sell personal information.
props.termsbodytext: Use of Unistellar products and services is governed by clear rules for acceptable use, billing, fulfillment, warranty limits, and dispute handling.
props.rightsbodytext: Qualified users can request access, correction, deletion, portability, or processing restrictions in line with applicable law.
props.sectionbodytext:
We collect the information needed to create accounts, process telescope orders, deliver software updates, and support observational sessions. This can include identifiers such as name and email address, payment and shipping details, device identifiers, diagnostic logs, telescope telemetry, support correspondence, and engagement history across web and mobile experiences.

We intentionally limit collection to information that helps us operate the service, meet legal obligations, investigate misuse, and improve reliability for connected hardware and companion applications.
props.sectionbodytext2:
Collected information is used to authenticate users, fulfill purchases, ship hardware, activate warranties, provide customer support, maintain service performance, and send operational messages tied to an account or transaction. Usage data also helps us understand reliability trends, improve firmware quality, and refine scientific discovery features.

Where consent is required for optional marketing, analytics, or personalized experiences, we rely on that consent and provide controls for withdrawal or preference changes.
props.sectionbodytext3:
We share data with carefully selected service providers that help us run payments, cloud hosting, logistics, customer support, diagnostics, and communications. These providers are contractually restricted to using information only for the services they perform on our behalf and must apply appropriate confidentiality and security measures.

We may also disclose information when required by law, to respond to valid legal requests, to enforce our agreements, or to protect the rights, safety, and integrity of our customers, employees, and platform.
props.sectionbodytext4:
Personal information is retained only for as long as needed to provide services, support purchases, maintain records, resolve disputes, satisfy legal obligations, and defend claims. We apply administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect account data, transactional records, and connected-device information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure.

When information moves across borders, we use recognized transfer mechanisms such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent safeguards to preserve privacy rights and enforceable protections.
props.sectionbodytext5:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to request access to personal data, correct inaccurate information, delete eligible records, object to certain processing, request portability, or limit how your information is used. Account owners can also manage some preferences directly through product settings, browser controls, and unsubscribe links where available.

We review verified requests in line with applicable law and may ask for additional information when necessary to protect account security or clarify the scope of a request.
props.sectionbodytext6:
Your use of Unistellar websites, software, connected services, and hardware purchases is also governed by the commercial and contractual terms that apply at checkout, during account creation, and within product experiences. Those terms cover account responsibilities, acceptable use, billing, fulfillment, warranty limitations, dispute procedures, and service availability.

We may revise this policy center from time to time to reflect legal, operational, or product changes. Material updates are posted here with a new effective date, and continued use after an update may constitute acceptance where permitted by law.
props.legalnoticebodytext: Privacy requests, legal notices, and accessibility-related inquiries can be sent to legal@unistellar.com. We retain prior versions of this policy center for transparency, auditability, and reference when material updates are issued.
props.noticemetatext: Archived versions are maintained when required for compliance, customer communication, or dispute resolution.
